# CANDIDATE: V14E_TRAIL_LOOSEN_020

**Filed:** 2026-08-18
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** exit_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

By loosening the profit-lock trail_pct from 0.15 to 0.20, we allow the runner to capture more of the big moves on winner days (like 5/04) while still protecting gains via the wider trail. On loser days, the wider trail might cause slightly larger losses, but we hope the increase in winner P&L more than compensates.

## Mechanism

Change the profit_lock_trail_pct parameter in params.json from 0.15 to 0.20. The profit_lock arms at +5% favor (unchanged) and then trails at 20% of the high-water mark (i.e., stop = HWM * 0.80). All other aspects of the v14e exit structure remain unchanged.
